clips.title: The story
paras: On an island south of Astranaar, the Ruins of Stardust lie under Felwood's spreading corruption. Bog beasts prowl the fallen sanctuary, but stardust shrubs still grow among its stones with healing power.

South of Astranaar, you find the Ruins of Stardust on a solitary island. The night elves once held this holy place in reverence. Now a sickly yellow-green hue clouds the water, stained by demonic rot draining south from Felwood, as at nearby Iris Lake. Local plant life has twisted into hostile bog beasts. They prowl the fallen masonry, their temperaments warped by the tainted lake.

Stardust shrubs still bloom among the ruins, untouched by the corruption in the soil and along the shore. Their leaves and blossoms can cleanse and heal. Shamans, herbalists, and local night elf defenders seek them for remedies against Ashenvale's encroaching decay.
